## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm check` and `pnpm test` pass (and `pnpm test:int` when touching gateway, crawler or db)
- [ ] Tests added or updated
- [ ] User- or agent-facing text goes through the i18n catalogs, in `en`, `pt-BR` and `es`
- [ ] New architectural decision recorded as an ADR in `docs/decisions` (if any)
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated under `[Unreleased]` (if user-visible)
- [ ] `AGENTS.md` updated (if commands or rules changed)
- [ ] No secrets, real personal data or PII in code, fixtures or logs
